speaker: Doctor
text: Can you tell me how long you have been experiencing this cough and shortness of breath, and does it worsen at night or with exertion? Are you currently smoking or have you been exposed to any chemicals or dust recently? REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Doctor

That is very helpful; the hyperinflation suggests air trapping. Do you experience wheezing or a "chest tightness" sensation when you breathe in? Have you noticed any recent fevers, night sweats, or unintended weight loss?

REQUEST TEST: Spirometry

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Spirometry Findings: FEV1/FVC ratio < 70%, indicating airflow obstruction.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD).
